source.title: Armagh Guardian, 18 May 1961, p. 1 ("Fight for Rural Council seat")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page, which is clean; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1961: the only contest was Annaghmore. In five divisions no nomination was received and the outgoing members were declared elected. The reports read name only the four new members and the Annaghmore candidates; the other 26 members (21 returned unopposed, five deemed re-elected) are not named. Returned unopposed. New member, succeeding Robert J. Irwin (the Armagh Guardian does not name the division; Irwin was the member for Tullyroan).
